# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome man of middle age with a strong, sad face that is splendidly modeled about the chin and brow. He has iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a very high-strung, sensitive, and reserved individual who possesses a deep and tender nature. His character is also defined by a strong sense of pride, which prevents him from returning to a place once he has left.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## Traits

## History

Twenty-five years prior, Stephen Irving became engaged to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), but their romance ended in a falling-out, leading Stephen to go away to the [States](../codex/places.md#states) and never return home. Decades later, his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) met Miss Lavendar and bonded with her, setting the stage for Stephen's eventual sudden arrival back in town. Upon his return, Stephen visited [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and asked her to relay a message to Miss Lavendar before going to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) himself. He happily reunited with Miss Lavendar in her garden, and the two were subsequently married there in the presence of family and friends before departing at the station.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P63](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0063), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P66](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0066), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P67](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0067), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P68](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0068), +144 more_

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is Stephen Irving's wife, though they spent years estranged following a past romantic falling-out. Upon his sudden arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Stephen used [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to relay a message to [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), leading to a emotional meeting at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) where they happily reunited. They were subsequently married in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together from the station.

- Spouse of — married in a ceremony in the honeysuckle arbor  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--stephen-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Stephen Irving's son. Stephen lives with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) was present to celebrate his father's eventual garden wedding to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

- Parent of — father of Paul  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023), +1 more</sub>
